mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing clear skies and a comfortable 75 degrees around the Verona Public Library. It is a fantastic night to look up, as we have a waxing crescent moon and a highly visible pass of the International Space Station starting at 9:31 PM tonight for about six minutes.

The City of Verona is highlighting several local environmental initiatives. Residents are encouraged to participate in water-saving efforts through the city's rain barrel and toilet rebate programs, or monitor their usage online with the Eye on Water tool. On the streets, the city is continuing its sustainability push by installing anti-idling technology on new ambulances and proactively upgrading streetlights to energy-efficient LEDs.

There are plenty of events to look forward to over the next few days. On July 19th, enjoy live music options at both Bailey's Run and Lake Louie, or visit the Mount Horeb Art Fair. Later in the week on Wednesday, July 22nd, make sure to visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park for fresh local goods and live music under the pavilion.

In our weekly police department update, on Friday, July 10th, an officer stopped a vehicle for an equipment violation. After K9 Drea alerted to the presence of drugs, the driver was cited for operating with a suspended license and possession of marijuana.

Make your evening a little sweeter by heading over to Culver's for their delicious Turtle flavor of the day. The store is open until 10 PM, so you have plenty of time to satisfy your sweet tooth. If you cannot make it tonight, tomorrow's featured flavor is Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Crunch.
